Pod exec session

Source: R/stream.R
PodExecSession.Rd

Pod exec session

Pod exec session

Details

Returned by pod_exec_open(). Carries an open WebSocket; demuxes the v4.channel.k8s.io subprotocol; routes server-to-client frames to user callbacks; sends client-to-server frames via write_stdin()/resize(). Incoming frames are dispatched while wait() or pump() runs.

Public fields

exit_code

Exit code reported by the kubelet on error channel, or NA_integer_ if the session ended without one.

error

Last error condition (a metav1.Status parsed list), or NULL.

Method close_stdin()

Signal EOF on the remote stdin. Needs the v5.channel.k8s.io subprotocol (Kubernetes 1.29+), which is offered first; servers that only speak v4 have no way to close stdin and ignore the message, so a command reading stdin to EOF keeps running until the session is closed.

Usage

PodExecSession$close_stdin()

Method pump()

Dispatch frames that arrive within timeout seconds to the registered callbacks. Returns as soon as the first frame (and any already queued behind it) has been handled, or after timeout.

Usage

PodExecSession$pump(timeout = 0)

Arguments

timeout

Seconds to wait for a frame (default 0, i.e. ~1 ms).

Returns

TRUE while the session is open, invisibly.

Method wait()

Block until the session closes or timeout elapses, dispatching frames in the meantime.

Usage

PodExecSession$wait(timeout = 60)

Arguments

timeout

Seconds (default 60).

Returns

TRUE if the session ended naturally; FALSE on timeout.
